bullets.title: TSM: Blowout Q2, FY26 Rev Guidance Raised to +40%+ YoY, Capex Hiked to $60-64B
bullets.body: TSMC Q2 EPS $4.31 (adj. $3.98) beat consensus $3.95; revenue $40.2B beat $39.3B; Q3 guide $44.6-45.8B well above $43B consensus. FY26 revenue guidance raised to 'slightly above 40%' vs. prior '>30%' on 'extremely robust' AI demand. Capex raised to $60-64B from $52-56B (implies ~50-60% y/y growth), with Arizona expanded by $100B to >$260B total. Gross margin 67.7% viewed as slight miss vs. 68-70% buy-side; 2nm ramp dilutes GM 3-4pp in 2H. TSMC plans 13 leading-edge fabs in Taiwan and partner with Amkor for US advanced packaging. CEO C.C. Wei: 'AI CAGR expectations higher than thought a quarter ago.' UBS calls the surprise capex hike a 'confidence signal in AI supply chain.'

bullets.title: NVDA: Jensen Huang Says 'We Are at the Beginning of the Cycle'; Japan AI Factory Deal
bullets.body: At public remarks, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang stated the company is still 'at the beginning of the cycle,' signaling sustained GPU demand runway. Goldman Sachs estimates AI agents could drive a 24x increase in token consumption by 2030, likely worsening chip shortages over the next 12-18 months. Separately, NVIDIA is partnering with Noetra to build Japan's first national-scale AI factory deploying 13,750 Vera CPUs and 27,500 Rubin GPUs across 140MW. Oppenheimer sees NVDA's 2H VR200 ramp extending performance lead; Hedgeye estimates ~$4.5B net China datacenter revenue from H200 chip approvals (200k units at $30k/chip premium).

bullets.title: Semis Pre-Market Selloff: MU -4.7%, WDC -7.3%, SNDK -6.8% on AI Momentum Unwind
bullets.body: Despite TSMC's strong print, the semiconductor complex sold off sharply in pre-market with WDC -7.3%, SNDK -6.8%, STX -6.1%, MU -4.7%, COHR -5.1%, GLW -4.9%, AMD -2.9%, TSEM -2.5%, and TSM itself -3.8%. Morgan Stanley notes AI tech momentum index down -24% since June 22; memory stocks Korean Hynix -10%, Samsung -7%, Kioxia -15% overnight. MS flags memory as 'next AI binding constraint' potentially rising from 12% to 40% of cloud capex by 2027, yet prefers NVDA and AVGO over MU and SNDK near-term. US bipartisan lawmakers are pushing Trump to ban Chinese memory chips from CXMT and YMTC, adding policy tail risk.

bullets.title: CDNS: Mizuho Reiterates Outperform ($400 PT) on AuraStack AI Agent, Sees TAM 3x Potential
bullets.body: Cadence announced AuraStack AI Super Agent for PCB and advanced packaging design, delivering up to 2x faster time-to-market and 15x higher productivity. Mizuho reiterated Outperform with $400 PT, arguing agentic AI could shift EDA spend from 11-12% to 33-36% of semiconductor R&D, potentially tripling core EDA TAM. AuraStack is accelerated by NVIDIA Blackwell/CUDA-X. Meaningful revenue contribution expected in FY27; a few million dollars possible in FY26.

bullets.title: UBER: KeyBanc Bullish on $14.8B Delivery Hero Deal; PT $105 (+22% Upside)
bullets.body: Uber acquiring Delivery Hero for €41.50/share ($14.8B equity value) at ~8x 2027E EV/EBITDA inclusive of >$1.2B run-rate synergies within 18 months. Deal adds 50M+ eligible cross-platform users and expands from 79 to 99 markets; cross-platform users generate 3x gross bookings vs. single-segment. Expected non-GAAP EPS accretive at close, HSD% accretive by year three. Prosus (~17%) irrevocably committed to tender. KeyBanc PT $105 (12.5x 2028E EV/EBITDA); current 8.6x vs. 19.2x three-year NTM median. Jefferies is more cautious, viewing only 9% premium to spot and calling base case a 'slow march out of public markets' for DH shareholders.

bullets.title: GOOGL/META/AMZN: Citi Raises 2027 CapEx Estimates Materially on AI Demand; FCF Goes Negative
bullets.body: Citi raised 2027E capex for GOOGL by ~21% to $308B, META by ~22% to $205B for ~14GW compute, and AMZN by ~12% to $288B; all three expected to generate negative FCF in 2027-28. AWS projected +32.5% YoY in Q2 and +40% YoY in 2027. Separately, EU Commission issued binding DMA orders requiring Google to share search data with rivals from January 2027 and enable Android AI interoperability by July 2027. The Economist reports Google DeepMind's Demis Hassabis has a plan to manage AI safely. 22V notes GOOGL/MSFT/META hyperscaler earnings (Jul 22-29) as the next critical catalyst for AI demand sentiment.

bullets.title: AAPL: China AI Approval Bullish; Exploring AI Chip Acquisitions; AppleCare+ Price Hike
bullets.body: Apple received approval to roll out Apple Intelligence in China, its #2 market after the US, viewed as a significant positive by Morgan Stanley. AAPL is reportedly exploring AI semiconductor acquisitions as current M2 Ultra cannot handle the largest Gemini workloads. AAPL also raised AppleCare+ prices by $0.50/month and $5/year. Street expects a steady June quarter with limited financial upside at 35x NTM; DRAM/NAND headwinds into 2027 and potential margin pressure on iPhone without a price increase noted as risks. AAPL at a 52-week high, up 57.8% YTD.

bullets.title: CRWD: Citi Raises PT to $250; Acquires XM Cyber IP (45+ Patents) for Attack Path Tech
bullets.body: Citi raised CrowdStrike's PT to $250 split-adjusted, citing confidence in high-20%s ARR growth near-term and mid-20s medium-term. Separately, CRWD announced acquisition of XM Cyber's intellectual property including 45+ patents and proprietary source code for attack path visualization and offensive simulation, adding to the Falcon platform. Transaction does not include XM Cyber's revenue or customers; Schwarz Digits will adopt the Falcon platform. Deal closes H2 FY27 pending regulatory approval.

bullets.title: TSEM: $3B Japan Expansion (incl. $1B Gov't Support); 2nm Fabs for Leading US Customers
bullets.body: Tower Semiconductor announced up to $3B investment in Japan, including $1B in Japanese government support, focused on 300mm silicon photonics, SiGe, and advanced packaging. First phase targets production readiness by late 2027. TSEM is also building multiple 2nm wafer fabs for mass production driven by strong multi-year demand from leading US customers, per conference commentary. TSEM stock trading -2.5% pre-market.

bullets.title: NET/AKAM: MS Flags Strongest Edge AI Share Gains; NET a Preferred Non-AI Capex Name
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley identifies Cloudflare (NET) as having the strongest share gains in edge compute, with 52% of partners migrating 10-30% of Cloudflare workloads from hyperscalers. NET is among Morgan Stanley's preferred 'non-AI capex' names alongside CRWD, PANW, SNOW, DDOG, MDB, SHOP, CVNA, SPOT, LYV.

bullets.title: GLW: JPMorgan Raises PT to $200 from $185; Trading -4.9% Pre-Market in Semis Selloff
bullets.body: JPMorgan raised its price target on Corning to $200 from $185, a constructive rating action. However, GLW is trading -4.9% pre-market alongside the broader semiconductor and optical components selloff.

bullets.title: NBIS/BE: Bloom Energy Secures $1.7B Oaktree Project Investment for Nebius AI Infrastructure
bullets.body: Industrial Development Funding and Oaktree announced a $1.7B project investment deploying Bloom Energy fuel cells for Nebius AI cloud infrastructure build-out. The May 2026 Master Fuel Cell Capacity agreement covers ~250MW guaranteed and ~328MW installed capacity across three 10-year phases; Nebius will pay up to $2.6B in aggregate service fees. MUFG provided senior debt; Morgan Stanley served as sole tax equity investor. OpCo Research notes BE is a 'poster-child of momentum AI infra trade which is weak to start' and cautions the stock may already be pricing in multiple deals of this size.

bullets.title: LULU: Truist Downgrades to Sell, PT Cut to $94 from $115 on Limited Recovery Visibility
bullets.body: Truist downgraded Lululemon to Sell from Hold and cut its price target to $94 from $115 citing limited recovery visibility and brand issues flagged by TikTok/Google Trends/Amex Platinum Reddit data. Morgan Stanley's resumption of specialty retail coverage echoes concerns, modeling LULU at ~LSD% growth and $10-11 EPS vs. Street's ~MSD% and ~$12; some bears see a path to $6 EPS on Americas reset risk.

bullets.title: PENN/MGM: Citizens Raises PENN PT to $26 on Regional Gaming Beat Expectations; Goldman Prefers RRR
bullets.body: Citizens expects regional gaming names to beat 2Q26 expectations on stable visitation and healthy spend-per-visit; PENN raised to $26 PT from $24 as top idea given completion of casino investment cycle and digital inflection expected in 2027+. Goldman Sachs separately named PENN and RRR as preferred Locals names into Q2, while MGM and WYNN may face ceiling from weaker June Vegas foot traffic. PENN also received a PT raise to $25 from $23 at Mizuho on World Cup tailwinds.

bullets.title: W (Wayfair): JPMorgan Retail Laterals Imply +9.5% 2Q Comp vs. Street +5.6%
bullets.body: JPMorgan's June retail sales lateral analysis using 1-year trends implies Wayfair 2Q comp of +9.5% vs. consensus +5.6%, and BOBS Discount +3.2% vs. +1.9%. Home furnishings returned to positive growth at +2.2% YoY in June vs. -2.1% in May. June overall retail sales grew +6.7% YoY; core retail up +8.3% with strength in sporting goods (+17.8%), consumer electronics (+10.5%), and ecommerce (+18.0%).

bullets.title: TKO: DC RESALE Act Passes, ~$95M EBITDA Hit to Ticketmaster in 2027
bullets.body: Washington DC passed the RESALE Act with a 10% resale price cap; Citi estimates ~$95M impact to Ticketmaster 2027E EBITDA if 20% of tickets are affected. TKO is also trading -5.0% in Canadian-listed shares this morning.

bullets.title: IONQ: Jefferies Initiates Buy ($85 PT) as Quantum Computing Commercialization Accelerates
bullets.body: Jefferies initiated IonQ at Buy with an $85 price target, citing a narrowing timeline between quantum milestones and real-world application. Quantinuum's IPO was 20x oversubscribed and trading ~30% above IPO price. Trump's June executive orders allocated ~$2B in federal program backing to nine quantum companies.

bullets.title: ETSY: Depop Sale to eBay Expected to Close July 30 per 8-K
bullets.body: Etsy filed an 8-K confirming it expects to complete the previously announced sale of Depop to eBay on July 30, 2026. ETSY stock was at $85.74 at the time of the alert; Wedbush initiated ETSY at Neutral in broader internet coverage initiation.

bullets.title: META: EU Orders Addictive Feature Changes on Facebook/Instagram; Ray-Ban AI Glasses to Blind Veterans
bullets.body: The EU ordered Meta to change addictive features on Facebook and Instagram under DMA enforcement, with UK also planning a default midnight curfew for teens on social media. Separately, Meta is donating 130,000 pairs of Ray-Ban AI glasses to blinded veterans worldwide, a positive brand/PR initiative. Citi raised META 2027E capex by ~22% to $205B for ~14GW compute capacity with negative FCF expected in 2027-28.

bullets.title: RMBS: South Korean Antitrust Raid; ITC Second Investigation Names NVDA, AVGO, GOOGL, SMCI as Co-Respondents
bullets.body: South Korean prosecutors raided Rambus, Renesas, and Montage Technology offices over suspected price collusion on chips supplied to Samsung. Separately, the ITC opened a second investigation into Samsung's use of NLST patents ('537/'937), naming Samsung, Google, Super Micro, Nvidia, and Broadcom as co-respondents; patents cover HBM and DDR5 RDIMM/MRDIMM used in AI infrastructure. Roth maintains NLST Buy ($5 PT vs. $2.69) as the broader complaint increases favorable settlement odds.
